iodine excretion can be expressed per gram of creatinine but only in areas with very low inter and intraindividual variation in
urinary creatinine. In clinical settings, the measurement of uptake of radioactive iodine is used.
Iodine functional tests relate to its impact on thyroid function. The measurement of thyroid hormones and of thyroglobulin –
a key precursor in the production of thyroid hormones – is performed by speciﬁc competitive radioimmunoassay or immunoﬂuori-
